classification: Authored source lower-gluteal candidates; actual seated support and moving appearance remain unaccepted.
selection: Explicit native quad rows on the inward-curving lower buttock, between source Z rows approximately 0.851320 and 0.887732; exclude the old minimum's crease row near 0.833333 and the rear-lobe apex row near 0.904500. Three adjacent rear panel columns form each context patch; its medial column is the contact core. This is an authored ID selection from actual source sections/photos, not a run-time coordinate or bone-weight classifier.

offlineSupportProxies.gapBandReason: Reuses the existing palm/sole 1 mm numerical fit tolerance; not a physical cloth thickness or art acceptance claim.
offlineSupportProxies.fractionReason: A majority of each authored medial core must participate, preventing one isolated minimum, edge, or tiny triangle from satisfying the proxy. These are explicit proposed authoring proxies, not measured acceptance limits.
offlineSupportProxies.centering: Each area-weighted support centroid must lie strictly inside both its core footprint and the actual finite saddle footprint, with opposite nonzero bike-Z signs. Their midpoint must lie on the bike centre plane within the existing 1 mm numerical fit tolerance. Track their fore/aft centroids; do not minimize only the deepest point.
offlineSupportProxies.coverage: Measure all triangles in each core separately; report projected overlap area, area in the signed gap band, area-weighted gap, range, centroid, connected overlap components, and exact triangle witnesses. Edge/point overlap has zero area and cannot count.
offlineSupportProxies.collision: Separately check the complete selected jeans/body/saddle neighborhoods for real triangle crossings; a projected signed gap alone is not a closed-volume collision test.
offlineSupportProxies.pose: Offline per bike: author pelvis X/Y, pelvis tilt and upper-body flex while solving the existing actual palm/sole frames with fixed segment lengths. Keep bilateral cores semantically fixed during solving; never replace them with a cheaper-contact triangle. Pose and appearance remain parent-judged.
offlineSupportProxies.runtime: Consume a frozen per-bike seated pose and cheap contact IK; pelvis stays seated during upper-body breathing. No dense triangle solve per frame.
